introHtml: Black business cards make a bold, sophisticated statement that stands out in any stack. The deep, dark backdrop creates high contrast for foil stamping, embossing, or white ink — perfect for executives, designers, and luxury brands. Whether you need a matte finish for a modern feel or a gloss UV coating for extra pop, black cards convey authority and elegance. Choose from thick cardstock options like 14pt or 16pt for a substantial hand feel that leaves a lasting impression on clients and partners.
